query: drop function if exists public.update_customer_profile(uuid, text); create or replace function public.update_customer_profile(p_token uuid, p_full_name text) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$ declare c public.customers; begin if length(btrim(p_full_name)) < 2 then raise exception 'invalid_name'; end if; select c.* into c from public.customers c join public.customer_sessions s on s.customer_id = c.id where s.token = p_token; if c is null then raise exception 'unauthorized'; end if; update public.customers set full_name = btrim(p_full_name) where id = c.id; return jsonb_build_object('full_name', btrim(p_full_name)); end $$; grant execute on function public.update_customer_profile(uuid, text) to anon;
